bhh_inq_1791889500000_ammon.message:
Hi Team,

I'm Ammon, an investment banker at Logan Growth Advisors. We've helped founders sell their businesses across 50+ closed deals totaling over $700M in transaction value.

We can get founder owned home health, home care, and hospice agencies the best pricing and terms when it comes time for a sale. Our process runs a competitive blind auction among hand-selected investors, and it's driven an average 40%+ valuation increase for our clients.

I'd welcome a conversation with the owner at Blessed Hearts Homecare about what we're seeing in the home health M&A market.

Ammon
